# Mythos @ Stage 11 — Abstract Emerge

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 11 |
| Canonical name | Abstract Emerge |
| Altitude | `orange` (Worldcentric emerging) |
| MHC Order | 10 (Abstract) |
| Kegan | 3→4 |
| Identity band | Worldcentric emerging |

## Expression on this line

Mythic capacity at Order 10 is mythic mastery: expert-level narrative depth that operates
beyond conscious rule-following, producing symbolic work that transcends inherited tradition.
The master storyteller who can improvise within the mythic canon, innovate beyond it, and
teach others to do the same.

The key advance over Stage 10 is that mythic capacity is now *abstract* — it can be reasoned
about as a general phenomenon (what makes mythic mastery possible? what enables symbolic
innovation?) rather than just experienced in specific contexts.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt fluency of expert narrative — the master storyteller who works beyond
  conscious rule-following.
- **UR:** the capacity to innovate within and beyond inherited tradition, producing genuinely
  new mythic expressions.
- **LL:** a mythic culture that values mastery and innovation — communities that support
  expert narrative development.
- **LR:** the institutional structures (narrative workshops, mythology programs, criticism)
  that recognize and support mythic mastery.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** mastery as ego — the master storyteller who becomes identified with their
  expertise, unable to appreciate other forms of narrative.
- **Dark allergy:** mastery absence — the individual who cannot or will not develop expert-level
  narrative depth.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved formal mythic modeling (Stage 12) while
  actually just demonstrating expert narrative experience without formal analysis.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with mythic mastery because it seems "elitist."

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Expert-level narrative depth:** the individual demonstrates mastery that operates beyond
  conscious rule-following.
- **Mythic innovation:** the individual produces genuinely new symbolic work that transcends
  inherited tradition.
- **Teaching capacity:** the master can transmit their narrative expertise to others.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Campbell, *The Power of Myth* (expert mythic narration); Eco, *The Role of the
Reader* (expert narrative competence).
**Open joints:** How does mythic mastery shade into formal mythic modeling (Stage 12)?
**Research debt:** pairs with `10-concrete-peak` (complex myth integration) and
`12-formal-landmark` (formal mythic modeling).
